caption:
Most paint looks the same under a showroom ceiling light. The test is a lamp held low, raking sideways across the wall.

Cheap paint sold as "flat" goes matte everywhere to hide brush strokes, so that raking light disappears into the surface with nothing to catch. A quality finish, even one labelled matte or eggshell, keeps a thin, even sheen that holds a ribbon of highlight the whole way along.

Bring a small torch to the paint aisle if you can. Angle it low across the sample card before you decide.
